# Director, Customer Experience Strategy

Company: GitLab
Tracker ID: gitlab_director_customer_experience_strategy
Location: Remote
Official URL: https://example.invalid/jobs/director-customer-experience-strategy

## Job Description

Lead customer experience strategy across a complex global organization. Build an operating cadence for leadership priorities, executive decision support, customer journey improvements, and cross-functional accountability. Partner with senior leaders to surface risks, synthesize customer feedback, improve service delivery, and turn practical recommendations into sustained operating improvements. Experience in Customer Success, SaaS, retention, and renewals is adjacent, but the core mandate is business operations, executive communications, and transformation advisory.
